text_block_list.name: Café Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—I am terribly sorry. Our window-side 
seats are fully booked for today...

text_block_list.name: Café Clerk
text_block_list.text:
How about a terrace seat instead? It's a 
dog-friendly area, so if you don't mind 
that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Woman Walking a Dog
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna run to the restroom 
real quick. Stay, okay? Be a good girl and 
wait right here!

text_block_list.name: Golden Retriever
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Golden Retriever
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
... ......Looking at me like that won't 
get you headpats.

text_block_list.name: Golden Retriever
text_block_list.text: Whine...?

text_block_list.name: Woman Walking a Dog
text_block_list.text:
I'm home~! Wait... Ah! I-I'm so sorry! Did 
my girl cause trouble for you...?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No, please don't pay it any mind.

On our day off, as I waited to meet up 
with <chrname> in front of the station……

text_block_list.name: Fundraising Man
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your donations...!

text_block_list.name: Fundraising Man
text_block_list.text:
Here are some photos of our rescue dogs as 
a thank-you! Please feel free to pick 
whichever one you like best.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
... ...Well then, I'll take the one that 
golden girl is having.

A few days after that incident, I picked 
up a photo of a Golden Retriever in the 
hallway. Thinking it might belong to 
Admire Groove, I brought it to her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ! That is……
choice_data_list: You really like dogs, don't you?

I saw you donating earlier. That was very 
sweet of you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I don't particularly like it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That isn't mine either. ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...The loose change was getting in the 
way, that's all. No other motive behind 
it—
choice_data_list: Ah! I have to go now... Here, take this!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ... ......It came back.
